claims.text: After prior long-acting cabotegravir PrEP: do integrase resistance testing first when feasible.
claims.quote: For patients with prior exposure to long-acting cabotegravir for preexposure prophylaxis (PrEP), integrase resistance testing should be performed when feasible before regimen selection.

claims.text: If ART must start before results: a boosted PI (darunavir/cobicistat or darunavir/ritonavir + emtricitabine or lamivudine) may be used as a temporary empiric option.
claims.quote: If ART must be initiated before resistance testing results are available, a boosted PI-based regimen (eg, darunavir/cobicistat or darunavir/ritonavir plus emtricitabine or lamivudine) may be used as a temporary empiric option pending results.

claims.text: Darunavir 800 mg + ritonavir 100 mg once daily with food (no darunavir resistance);
claims.quote: 800 mg (one 800 mg tablet) taken with ritonavir 100 mg once daily and with food.

claims.text: 600 mg + ritonavir 100 mg BID with food if at least one darunavir resistance substitution.
claims.quote: Treatment-experienced adult patients with at least one darunavir resistance associated substitution: 600 mg (one 600 mg tablet) taken with ritonavir 100 mg twice daily and with food.

claims.text: Always take darunavir with ritonavir and food; otherwise it can lose efficacy.
claims.quote: PREZISTA must be co-administered with ritonavir and food to achieve the desired antiviral effect. Failure to administer PREZISTA with ritonavir and food may result in a loss of efficacy of darunavir.

claims.text: Low-dose ritonavir (eg, 100 mg daily) boosts other PIs by inhibiting their hepatic metabolism.
claims.quote: the efficacy of protease inhibitors (PIs) can be enhanced by co-administering a low dose of oral ritonavir (eg, 100 mg once daily), which inhibits the hepatic enzyme that metabolizes the other PIs

claims.text: PIs (CYP450) raise levels of other drugs;
claims.quote: Hepatic metabolism of PIs by cytochrome P-450: The result is decreased metabolism and, therefore, increased levels of other medications.

claims.text: darunavir/ritonavir is CI with narrow-therapeutic-index drugs highly dependent on CYP3A.
claims.quote: Co-administration of PREZISTA/ritonavir is contraindicated with drugs that are highly dependent on CYP3A for clearance and for which elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious and/or life-threatening events (narrow therapeutic index).

claims.text: St John's wort lowers PI and NNRTI levels.
claims.quote: St. John's wort can enhance metabolism of PIs and NNRTIs and thus decreases plasma PI and NNRTI levels.

claims.text: Drug-induced hepatitis can occur: check liver function before and during therapy, especially with chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis or raised baseline transaminases.
claims.quote: Drug-induced hepatitis (e.g., acute hepatitis, cytolytic hepatitis) has been reported with PREZISTA/ritonavir. Monitor liver function before and during therapy, especially in patients with underlying chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, or in patients who have pre-treatment elevations of transaminases.
